units.source_text: 龙头鹢首的游船都用中国风格的装饰。

en.t: The pleasure boats with dragon heads and egret prows were all decorated in Chinese style.

units.source_text: 把舵操棹的童子，头发一概结成总角，身穿中国式的服装。

en.t: The boys who steered the rudders and handled the poles all had their hair tied in hornlike knots and wore Chinese-style clothing.

units.source_text: 不曾见惯此种情景的侍女，在这等宽阔的湖中乘船，似觉真个是泛海远赴异国，大家怀着无穷的兴趣。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting, unused to such sights, rode out on so broad a lake and felt as though they were truly crossing the sea to a distant foreign land, each filled with endless delight.

units.source_text: 游船进入浮岛港湾中岩阴之下，但见其中小小的岩石，也都像画中景物。

en.t: When the pleasure boats entered the cove of the floating island beneath the shadow of the rocks, even the small stones there looked like scenery from a painting.

units.source_text: 各处树木上春云叆叇，犹如蒙着锦绣帐幕。

en.t: Spring clouds hung thickly over the trees everywhere, as if brocade curtains had been drawn across them.

units.source_text: 其间遥遥望见紫姬的春殿。

en.t: Through them, Lady Murasaki's spring palace could be seen far in the distance.

units.source_text: 这春殿里柳色增浓，长条垂地；花气袭人，芬芳无比。

en.t: In this spring palace the willows had deepened in color, their long branches trailing to the ground, while the scent of flowers pressed upon the senses with incomparable fragrance.

units.source_text: 别处樱花已过盛期，此间正在盛开。

en.t: Elsewhere the cherry blossoms had already passed their height, but here they were in full bloom.

units.source_text: 绕廊的紫藤，也渐次开花，鲜丽夺目。

en.t: The wisteria around the gallery was also gradually coming into bloom, brilliant and dazzling to the eye.

units.source_text: 棣棠花尤为繁茂，倒影映入池中，枝叶又从岸上挂到水里。

en.t: The yellow kerria blossoms were especially luxuriant, their reflections falling into the pond while their branches and leaves hung from the bank down into the water.

units.source_text: 各种水鸟，有的雌雄成对，双双游泳，有的口衔细枝，来往飞翔。

en.t: All kinds of water birds were there: some male and female in pairs, swimming side by side, and others flying back and forth with slender twigs in their beaks.

units.source_text: 鸳鸯浮在罗纹一般的春波上，竟是美丽的图案纹样。

en.t: Mandarin ducks floated on the spring ripples like patterned gauze, becoming a beautiful design in themselves.

units.source_text: 遨游其间，正像身入烂柯山中，年月都忘记了。

en.t: Roaming among all this, one felt as though one had entered Mount Lanke and had forgotten the passing of years and months.
The ladies-in-waiting each composed a new poem:
